correction: A branch guard must fetch with an explicit destination refspec (git fetch origin +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main): a remote without a fetch refspec leaves refs/remotes/origin/main stale, so a guard that trusts it passes wrongly; and a test's git environment must drop every inherited GIT_* variable (GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT or similar), so a test git command cannot write the caller's index.
evidence: frostyard/updex#510 cross-review (openai/gpt-6.1-sol) of head 92227fb, findings 1 and 2
